listings.title: Production-Grade OpenClaw/Moltbot Deployment
listings.pain_statement: Most OpenClaw/Moltbot setups die within a week. The gateway crashes, sessions get stuck, models hallucinate, and nobody set up monitoring.
listings.proof: I've been running a 20+ agent OpenClaw system since January 2026 — daily. Multi-model routing across four LLM providers, Docker deployment with health checks, automated restarts, full monitoring dashboard. Total operating cost: $1,337/month — less than a junior dev's monthly salary.

listings.title: AI Automation Pipeline (Make.com + LLM)
listings.pain_statement: Automation tools are easy to demo and hard to run reliably. The difference between a Make.com scenario that works once and one that runs for months without intervention is error handling, retry logic, token management, and monitoring.
listings.proof: My production system runs five Make.com scenarios handling content generation, video pipelines (HeyGen to YouTube), newsletter distribution (Beehiiv), social media scheduling (Typefully), and CRM updates — all connected to LLM-powered decision logic. ~50 daily tasks processed, errors fire to Telegram within 90 seconds.

listings.title: Claude Code Professional Setup
listings.pain_statement: Most Claude Code setups stop at installing the CLI. Yours won't.
listings.proof: Mine runs 14 custom agents, 25+ specialized commands, 22 MCP server integrations, automated testing pipelines, and security audit workflows — in daily production since January 2026. A pre-flight gate catches regressions before merge.

listings.title: AI Knowledge Base & Infrastructure Setup
listings.pain_statement: Most AI agent projects fail not because the agents are bad, but because they have nothing to work with. PDFs in a shared drive, knowledge spread across email threads, processes that exist only in people's heads.
listings.proof: I operate a structured knowledge system with 147 database migrations and a dual architecture: SQL for quantitative data (no hallucination on numbers) and a Markdown-based knowledge system for qualitative context. This feeds 20+ autonomous agents daily that have never hallucinated a cost figure or KPI in 4 months.

phase_zero_note: When building agents/pipelines/Claude Code setups for clients without structured data, recommend Knowledge Base Foundation phase first (3-7 days). Listing 4 covers this.
